notes.title: 📔 Date release update 📔
notes.notes:
Dear Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories Community,

I hope this message finds you well. I wanted to take a moment to express my gratitude for your unwavering support and enthusiasm for our game, Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories. Your feedback, encouragement, and dedication have been invaluable throughout this journey.

I have an important update to share with you all. As some of you may know, I have been collaborating with a friend on this project. However, circumstances have led my friend to pursue other endeavors, and as a result, I have decided to continue developing Neverending Check-in solo.

While this transition may bring its challenges, I want to assure you that I am fully committed to delivering the best possible experience. I am incredibly passionate about this project, and I am determined to see it through to completion.

With this in mind, I have adjusted our release timeline slightly. The new anticipated release date for Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories is now set for the second quarter of 2025. This extra time will allow me to ensure that every aspect of the game meets the high standards that you, the community, deserve.

I understand that waiting for something you're excited about can be tough, but I genuinely believe that the final product will be worth it. Your patience and continued support mean the world to me, and I cannot thank you enough for standing by me on this journey.

Please stay tuned for further updates as development progresses. I will make sure to keep you informed every step of the way. Together, we'll make Neverending Check-in: The Hotel Stories everything we've dreamed it to be.

Thank you once again for your incredible support and understanding.

Warm regards,
Oleksii
